source: Registry-linked official school rosters with proven source bytes and organization identity
inventoryScope: Complete selected labeled-template review; only independently proven new teacher identities are emitted.

selection.selection: Remaining current-license empty checkpoints with owned labeled roster grids. Original organization proofs, page checksums and name/position association are revalidated.

review.method: All selected current-license empty format-review checkpoints are audited. Only sources whose cached UTF-8 bytes match original response checksums and whose organization identity re-validates are emitted. Each person retains a single source row: explicit disciplines outrank teaching-position subjects, which outrank unpublished subjects. Subjects from different pages are never unioned under one source hash. Original checkedAt times and source hashes are retained; this is a cache re-read, not a fresh fetch.

sourceAudit.method: Each new teacher name, subject and provenance was independently re-read from its exact URL and SHA256-proven HTML bytes. No multi-page subject unions are accepted.
